lines.zh: 我在半影森林里闲逛，这些树长得真高。
lines.en: I stroll through the Penumbral Forest, these trees are so tall.

lines.zh: 这木质坚硬得很，得用斧头砍。
lines.en: This wood is really hard, need an axe to cut.

lines.zh: 发光树叶落下来，我得拾起来。
lines.en: The glowing leaves drop, I better pick them up.

lines.zh: 甲片能做成我的盔甲。
lines.en: Shell fragments make great armor for me.

lines.zh: 末地的环境真是独特。
lines.en: The End's environment is so unique.

lines.zh: 我在半影森林漫步，享受这份宁静。
lines.en: I walk in the Penumbral Forest, enjoying the peace here.

lines.zh: 这里的树木是全游戏最高的。
lines.en: These trees are the tallest in the game.

lines.zh: 我得小心那些树，它们非常高。
lines.en: I need to be careful with the trees, they're very tall.

lines.zh: 发光树叶很有用，可以防止辐射。
lines.en: The glowing leaves are useful, they protect me from radiation.

lines.zh: 我只在半影森林出现，这里是我的家。
lines.en: I only spawn in the Penumbral Forest, this is my home.

lines.zh: 我的壳片蹭着硬木，沙沙响。
lines.en: My shell plates rasp against the hard wood.

lines.zh: 发光树叶落下的果子，甜得很。
lines.en: The fruit the glow leaves drop is sweet.

lines.zh: 我站在一棵高树旁，享受阳光。
lines.en: I stand next to a tall tree, basking in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 这片森林里偶尔会有甲片掉落。
lines.en: Shell fragments occasionally fall in this forest.

lines.zh: 我在这里悠闲地走动，寻找食物。
lines.en: I walk around leisurely, looking for food.

lines.zh: 这些树是我生存的依靠。
lines.en: These trees are my survival.

lines.zh: 末地的孤岛环境让我感到孤独。
lines.en: The isolated End environment makes me feel lonely.

lines.zh: 我在末地的半影森林中漫步。
lines.en: I walk around the Penumbral Forest in the End.

lines.zh: 这片森林保留了末地的荒凉感。
lines.en: This forest preserves the desolation of the End.

lines.zh: 我享受着这份孤独和宁静。
lines.en: I enjoy this solitude and peace.

lines.zh: 末地生物只能在这片森林中找到。
lines.en: Only creatures like me can be found in this forest.

lines.zh: 我在这里等待猎物的到来。
lines.en: I wait here for prey to come close.

lines.zh: 氡气漫过来，我连眼皮都不抬。
lines.en: Radon drifts past, and I don't even blink.

lines.zh: 一整套甲壳，都从我身上来。
lines.en: A whole suit of shell comes from my kind.

lines.zh: 我感觉到了你的气息，玩家。Anklor is sensing your presence, player.
lines.en: I feel your presence, player.

lines.zh: 半影森林里，我不怕你。In the Penumbral Forest, I fear no one.
lines.en: In the Penumbral Forest, I fear no one.

lines.zh: 你别想接近我！Don't even think about getting close to me!
lines.en: Don't even think about getting close to me!

lines.zh: 我的甲壳坚硬无比！My armor is incredibly tough!
lines.en: My armor is incredibly tough!

lines.zh: 别想伤害我，你会后悔的。Don't even think about hurting me, you'll regret it.
lines.en: Don't even think about hurting me, you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 警告你，别招惹我！Warning: don't mess with me!
lines.en: Warning: don't mess with me!

lines.zh: 末地的生物，我掌控半影森林。As a creature of the End, I control the Penumbral Forest.
lines.en: As a creature of the End, I control the Penumbral Forest.

lines.zh: 你在这里很危险，快离开！This place is dangerous for you, get out now!
lines.en: This place is dangerous for you, get out now!

lines.zh: 我的甲壳可以挡住任何攻击。My armor can block any attack.
lines.en: My armor can block any attack.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，不然你会后悔的。Stay back, or you'll regret it.
lines.en: Stay back, or you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 你身上有末地的味道，玩家。
lines.en: You carry the scent of the End, player.

lines.zh: 斧头别对着我的树。
lines.en: Keep that axe away from my trees.

lines.zh: 再靠近，我的角就顶过来。
lines.en: Come closer and my horn will meet you.

lines.zh: 我在这片半影里看着你。
lines.en: I am watching you from the penumbra.

lines.zh: 骨鲠在喉
lines.en: Sharp bone in throat.

lines.zh: 哀嚎遍野
lines.en: Howls echo through the forest.

lines.zh: 甲缝里全是热气。
lines.en: Heat steams from my seams.

lines.zh: 这块甲壳裂到了肉。
lines.en: This plate is cracked to the flesh.

lines.zh: 甲片掉了两片，还撑得住。
lines.en: Two plates are gone; I still hold.

lines.zh: 我的壳在响，站不太稳。
lines.en: My shell creaks; I barely stand.

lines.zh: 半影森林里，甲片一响。
lines.en: In the Penumbral Forest, my shell plates click.

lines.zh: 狂暴挣扎
lines.en: Wild thrashing.

lines.zh: 生命垂危
lines.en: On the brink of death.

lines.zh: 嘶吼连连
lines.en: Continuous roars.

lines.zh: 这棵树是我的骄傲，你来试试看。This tree is my pride, come and try to take it from me.
lines.en: This tree is my pride, come and try to take it from me.

lines.zh: 发光树叶给我带来力量。The glow leaves give me strength.
lines.en: The glow leaves give me strength.

lines.zh: 半影森林的树，是坚硬的木材之王。Penumbral Forest's trees are the kings of hard wood.
lines.en: Penumbral Forest's trees are the kings of hard wood.

lines.zh: 你吃我的肉，会短暂免疫辐射。Eating my meat will give you temporary radiation resistance.
lines.en: Eating my meat will give you temporary radiation resistance.

lines.zh: 不要轻易接近我，我是安克洛兽。Don't get too close to me, I'm an Anklor.
lines.en: Don't get too close to me, I'm an Anklor.

lines.zh: 我的甲片可以做成护甲，但不要想伤害我。My shell fragments can make armor, but don't even think about harming me.
lines.en: My shell fragments can make armor, but don't even think about harming me.

lines.zh: 末地的生物，我是末地的守护者。As a creature of the End, I am its guardian.
lines.en: As a creature of the End, I am its guardian.

lines.zh: 我是这里的霸主，你别想挑衅我。I am the lord of this realm, don't try to provoke me.
lines.en: I am the lord of this realm, don't try to provoke me.

lines.zh: 发光树叶是我的食物，它们让我更强。The glow leaves are my food, they make me stronger.
lines.en: The glow leaves are my food, they make me stronger.

lines.zh: 半影森林里，我是无敌的。In the Penumbral Forest, I am invincible.
lines.en: In the Penumbral Forest, I am invincible.

lines.zh: 我讨厌被这些笨拙的末影人推来搡去！
lines.en: I hate being shoved around by those clumsy Endermen!

lines.zh: 我的盔甲片保护我免受末地的辐射！
lines.en: My shell fragments shield me from the End's radiation!

lines.zh: 这些树枝太硬，斧头才是硬茬！
lines.en: These branches are tough; axes are where it's at!

lines.zh: 我得赶紧回去吃树叶恢复活力！
lines.en: Time to get back and munch on leaves for energy!

lines.zh: 这笨拙的家伙又来捣乱了！
lines.en: That clumsy one's at it again!

lines.zh: 半影森林是我的领地，别想侵入！
lines.en: Penumbral Forest is my territory, stay out!

lines.zh: 这些树高得离谱，但我还是喜欢这里！
lines.en: These trees are absurdly tall, but I still love it here!

lines.zh: 别靠近我，我可不想变成肉！
lines.en: Stay back, I don't want to turn into meat!

lines.zh: 我在树上休息，别吵我！
lines.en: I'm resting in the trees, leave me alone!

lines.zh: 末影人的推搡让我生气！
lines.en: The Endermen's shoves annoy me!

lines.zh: 找到配偶的感觉真好！
lines.en: It feels great to find a mate!

lines.zh: 一起吃树叶，甜蜜又温馨！
lines.en: Munching leaves together, sweet and cozy!

lines.zh: 和我的伴侣一起，这里就完美了！
lines.en: With my partner here, this is perfect!

lines.zh: 我们互相依赖，共同生存！
lines.en: We rely on each other, surviving together!

lines.zh: 我需要保护我的伴侣，这是责任！
lines.en: I need to protect my partner, that's my duty!

lines.zh: 找到伴侣让我更加坚强！
lines.en: Finding a mate makes me stronger!

lines.zh: 我们的力量结合在一起！
lines.en: Our strength combined!

lines.zh: 伴侣给了我勇气！
lines.en: My partner gave me courage!

lines.zh: 彼此依偎，温暖心灵！
lines.en: Snuggling up, warming our hearts!

lines.zh: 我会一直守护我们的爱！
lines.en: I'll always protect our love!

lines.zh: 拾取安克洛甲片后
lines.en: After picking up Anklor Shell Fragments,

lines.zh: 拾取安克洛肉后
lines.en: After picking up Anklor Meat,

lines.zh: 拾取安克洛甲片后，可以制作护甲
lines.en: After picking up Anklor Shell Fragments, armor can be crafted.

lines.zh: 拾取安克洛肉后，可以食用获得抗性
lines.en: After picking up Anklor Meat, eat it to gain temporary resistance.

lines.zh: 拾取安克洛甲片，是制作护甲的材料
lines.en: Anklor Shell Fragments, materials for armor.

lines.zh: 拾取安克洛肉，食用可提升耐久
lines.en: Anklor Meat, eat it to boost durability.

lines.zh: 拾起一片坚硬的甲片
lines.en: Picked up a tough shell fragment

lines.zh: 咬下一块坚实的肉，能让人更强壮
lines.en: Bit into tough meat, making me stronger

lines.zh: 安克洛甲片是制作护甲的好材料
lines.en: Anklor Shell Fragments are good for armor crafting

lines.zh: 安克洛肉吃了能让人更强壮
lines.en: Anklor Meat boosts strength when eaten

lines.zh: 你来了，准备迎接战斗吧！
lines.en: You're here, get ready for battle!

lines.zh: 甲片一层层，箭都弹开。
lines.en: Plate on plate, arrows bounce off.

lines.zh: 我的力气大得很，小心点！
lines.en: My strength is great, be careful!

lines.zh: 我会保护我的树不被砍伐！
lines.en: I'll protect my tree from being cut down!

lines.zh: 我的安克洛甲片不是玩具，小心使用！
lines.en: My Anklor shell fragments aren't toys, use them carefully!

lines.zh: 我的肉是强壮之源，吃了试试！
lines.en: My meat is a source of strength, try eating it!

lines.zh: 别想靠近我，我会攻击！
lines.en: Don't think about getting close, I'll attack!

lines.zh: 我的甲片可制成护甲，别破坏！
lines.en: My shell can be used for armor, don't destroy them!

lines.zh: 我是末地的半影森林的守护者！
lines.en: I'm the protector of the Penumbral Forest of the End!

lines.zh: 我免疫氡辐射，别担心我的安全！
lines.en: I'm radon immune, don't worry about my safety!

lines.zh: 砍我树的人，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the one who fells my trees.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的林间空地了。
lines.en: You have stepped into my clearing.

lines.zh: 半影林的影子动了。
lines.en: The penumbral shade is moving.

lines.zh: 小心它的尾巴！
lines.en: Watch out for its tail!

lines.zh: 别让它的爪子碰到你！
lines.en: Don't let its claws touch you!

lines.zh: 安克洛甲片，坚硬如石！
lines.en: Anklor shells, hard as stone!

lines.zh: 吃发光树叶，抗性加成！
lines.en: Eat glow leaves, resistance boosted!

lines.zh: 半影森林的守护者！
lines.en: Guardian of Penumbral Forest!

lines.zh: 致命的半影森林！
lines.en: Deadly Penumbral Forest!

lines.zh: 它的力量不容小觑！
lines.en: Its power is formidable!

lines.zh: 安克洛，末地之谜！
lines.en: Anklor, the End mystery!

lines.zh: 躲避它的攻击！
lines.en: Dodge its attacks!

lines.zh: 它低下头，准备冲撞！
lines.en: It lowers its head to charge!

lines.zh: 别站在它角的正前方！
lines.en: Don't stand in front of its horn!

lines.zh: 甲壳底下藏着暴怒。
lines.en: Rage is hiding under that shell.

lines.zh: 我来了，森林颤抖
lines.en: I came, the forest trembles

lines.zh: 我的甲壳坚不可摧
lines.en: My shell is unbreakable

lines.zh: 你触碰我即死亡
lines.en: Touch me, and you die

lines.zh: 在这阴影中生存
lines.en: Survive in this shade

lines.zh: 半影森林的王者
lines.en: King of the Penumbral Forest

lines.zh: 恐惧与我同在
lines.en: Fear accompanies me

lines.zh: 我的利爪撕裂一切
lines.en: My claws tear through all

lines.zh: 我的眼睛如炬
lines.en: My eyes are torches

lines.zh: 我的吼声震动末地
lines.en: My roar shakes the End

lines.zh: 半影中的巨人
lines.en: Giants of the Penumbral

lines.zh: 我的角撞碎你的剑
lines.en: My horn shatters your sword

lines.zh: 这一下，够你记住森林
lines.en: This blow will make you remember the forest

lines.zh: 我在这片半影森林中寻找着生存的机会。
lines.en: I seek survival in the Penumbral Forest.

lines.zh: 这些坚硬的木质让我难以采伐。
lines.en: These hard woods make it difficult to harvest.

lines.zh: 我讨厌这种放射性的元素，但又离不开它。
lines.en: I hate this radioactive element, but I can't live without it.

lines.zh: 这片森林里，树最高，生存最艰难。
lines.en: In this forest, the trees are tallest, and survival is most difficult.

lines.zh: 我的肉可以提供短暂的抗性，这也是我的价值。
lines.en: My meat provides temporary resistance, which is my worth.

lines.zh: 每当夜晚来临，我就开始寻找食物。
lines.en: Every night, I search for food.

lines.zh: 我习惯于这片森林的稀疏，但总想探索更多。
lines.en: I'm accustomed to the sparseness of this forest, but I always want to explore more.

lines.zh: 我的甲片可以制成一套特殊的护甲。
lines.en: My shells can be crafted into special armor.

lines.zh: 我必须小心翼翼，以免落入敌人的陷阱。
lines.en: I must be careful to avoid falling into enemies' traps.

lines.zh: 我在半影森林中寻找着稀有的资源。
lines.en: I search for rare resources in the Penumbral Forest.

lines.zh: 我从发光树叶下醒来，壳上带着露。
lines.en: I wake beneath the glow leaves, dew on my shell.

lines.zh: 这片林地由我守着，树一棵都不能少。
lines.en: I guard this grove; not one tree may be lost.

lines.zh: 末地本来就空，我早习惯了。
lines.en: The End is empty anyway — I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 火焰烧得我皮开肉绽
lines.en: Burnin' hot, my hide's peelin' off

lines.zh: 摔落让我骨骼寸断
lines.en: Fallen long, bones shattered

lines.zh: 溺水让我喘不过气
lines.en: Choke on water, can't breathe

lines.zh: 爆炸的威力让我五脏六腑俱裂
lines.en: Explosion tore my insides out

lines.zh: 投射物击穿了我的身体
lines.en: Arrow pierced my flesh

lines.zh: 魔法化为灰烬，我化为烟雾
lines.en: Magic's ashes, I'm but a puff

lines.zh: 饥饿噬咬着我的肉身
lines.en: Hunger gnaws, flesh torn

lines.zh: 雷击撕裂了我的肌肉
lines.en: Lightning split my flesh

lines.zh: 虚空侵蚀着我的存在
lines.en: Void eats me away
